export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/madhur-agri-overseas-limited) reports "Total Shipments 27 Records detected", "Trading Partners 2", "Ports 4", "Latest Cargo 2026-01-17". Rows actually visible on the free page: 5 shipment rows (counter says 27). Exact row quoted: "2026-01-17 | MADHUR AGRI OVERSEAS LIMITED | TO ORDER, MOROCCO | INDIA ORIGIN GREEN MILLETS 99% PURITY MACHINE CLEAN ... MUNDRA SEA INMUN1, India | Casablanca, MOROCCO | 10082920 | 8821774". Other visible rows: 2025-12-26 to Da Nang, Vietnam, HS 12024210, BOL 8213227 (80/90 Java groundnut kernels, ex-Pipavav); 2025-09-09 to Casablanca, Morocco, HS 10082920, BOL 9591512 (green millets, ex-Mundra); 2025-06-29 to Thessaloniki, Greece, HS 12074090, BOL 3130893 (hulled sesame seeds, ex-Mundra); plus one import row 2025-07-05 raw cashew nuts in shell HS 08013100, BOL 3087711, supplier COAF FZCO Dubai, origin Ghana, into Tuticorin.
note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records with destination, HS code and BOL number — not a website claim. Note the declared HS 200811 (prepared/preserved groundnuts) does NOT match the actual shipment HS codes seen (10082920 millets, 12024210 groundnut kernels, 12074090 sesame seeds, 08013100 raw cashew in shell): the company is an agricultural raw-commodity exporter, so the HS code should be corrected to the factual codes; per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could not be retrieved: search backend was unavailable (searx connection refused), Google returned HTTP 429, and Tofler (404), TheCompanyCheck (403) and ZaubaCorp (403) blocked access — so domestic_status is unknown, not none_found. Revenue and export volume figures are not public on the free views: null, not estimated. Trader/manufacturer role not determinable from shipment data alone (mixed export of own-origin goods and import of raw cashew for processing suggests manufacturer_trader, but unverified).
